terms.definition: A lipid bilayer along with all the proteins and protein complexes embedded in it and attached to it.
terms.authority_only: Term identity and definition do not establish an experimental protein annotation or a substrate-specific transport event.

terms.definition: The membrane surrounding a cell that separates the cell from its external environment. It consists of a phospholipid bilayer and associated proteins.
terms.authority_only: Term identity and definition do not establish an experimental protein annotation or a substrate-specific transport event.

terms.definition: Enables the transfer of substances, sized less than 1000 Da, from one side of a membrane to the other. The transmembrane portions of porins consist exclusively of beta-strands which form a beta-barrel. They are found in the outer membranes of Gram-negative bacteria, mitochondria, plastids and possibly acid-fast Gram-positive bacteria.
terms.authority_only: Term identity and definition do not establish an experimental protein annotation or a substrate-specific transport event.

terms.definition: The process in which carboxylic acid is transported across a membrane.
terms.authority_only: Term identity and definition do not establish an experimental protein annotation or a substrate-specific transport event.

terms.definition: Enables the transfer of monocarboxylic acids from one side of a membrane to the other. A monocarboxylic acid is an organic acid with one COOH group.
terms.authority_only: Term identity and definition do not establish an experimental protein annotation or a substrate-specific transport event.

terms.definition: The directed movement of monocarboxylic acids into, out of or within a cell, or between cells, by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore.
terms.authority_only: Term identity and definition do not establish an experimental protein annotation or a substrate-specific transport event.

terms.definition: The directed movement of organic acids, any acidic compound containing carbon in covalent linkage, into, out of or within a cell, or between cells, by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore.
terms.authority_only: Term identity and definition do not establish an experimental protein annotation or a substrate-specific transport event.

terms.definition: The process in which a solute is transported across a lipid bilayer, from one side of a membrane to the other.
terms.authority_only: Term identity and definition do not establish an experimental protein annotation or a substrate-specific transport event.

terms.definition: Enables the transfer of a substance, usually a specific substance or a group of related substances, from one side of a membrane to the other.
terms.authority_only: Term identity and definition do not establish an experimental protein annotation or a substrate-specific transport event.

terms.definition: The directed movement of carboxylic acids into, out of or within a cell, or between cells, by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore. Carboxylic acids are organic acids containing one or more carboxyl (COOH) groups or anions (COO-).
terms.authority_only: Term identity and definition do not establish an experimental protein annotation or a substrate-specific transport event.

terms.definition: Enables the transfer of carboxylic acids from one side of a membrane to the other. Carboxylic acids are organic acids containing one or more carboxyl (COOH) groups or anions (COO-).
terms.authority_only: Term identity and definition do not establish an experimental protein annotation or a substrate-specific transport event.
